Class LlmRouter

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.llm.LlmRouter
@Component public class LlmRouter extends Object
The LlmRouter class is the map from a provider id to a LlmProvider. The caller supplies the prompt. The complete methods do not take a cell record. The router does not read stored chat memory. The router does not add a mood line. // @aa-sdd G-05 aetheris-stages-1-3.finalize.md

  • Method Details

    • complete

      public org.springframework.ai.chat.model.ChatResponse complete(String target, org.springframework.ai.chat.prompt.Prompt prompt) throws Exception
      The method completes a prompt with factory Grok options and no thinking sink. The method does not take a cell record. An empty target selects ollama.
      Parameters:
      target - The target is a provider id, or provider/model.
      prompt - The prompt is the caller-built prompt.
      Returns:
      The return value is the completion.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception for an unknown provider or a backend failure.

    • complete

      public org.springframework.ai.chat.model.ChatResponse complete(String target, org.springframework.ai.chat.prompt.Prompt prompt, GrokCallOptions options, String think, GrokLlmService.HttpSlot slot, GrokLlmService.DeltaSink sink) throws Exception
      The method sends the prompt to Grok, to Ollama, or to another mapped provider. The id grok calls GrokLlmService.completeFor(String, Prompt). The id ollama calls SpringAiOllamaLlmService.complete(Prompt, String, String, GrokLlmService.DeltaSink). Any other id uses LlmProvider.complete(Prompt). A missing provider throws LlmRouter.UnknownProviderException. Grok uses options, the slot, and the sink. Ollama uses the model text after the slash, the think string, and the sink. A null think string is sent as empty. A set think string streams kind t. A null sink keeps the one-shot call. This method does not take a cell record.
      Parameters:
      target - The target is a provider id, or provider/model.
      prompt - The prompt is the caller-built prompt.
      options - The options are the Grok body fields. Other providers ignore them.
      think - The think text is empty when thinking is off, true for the checkbox, or an Ollama level.
      slot - The slot receives the chat HTTP future. The probe future is not this slot.
      sink - The sink receives thinking chunks. The sink is null when thinking is off.
      Returns:
      The return value is the completion.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception for an unknown provider or a backend failure.

    • startGrokProbe

      public CompletableFuture<Void> startGrokProbe(String model, String effort, boolean sendEffort) throws Exception
      The method starts one Hello probe for this server process. The returned future is the probe future. An empty effort becomes high inside the probe body when the field is sent. A false send flag leaves reasoning_effort off the Hello body.
      Parameters:
      model - The model is the model id.
      effort - The effort is this request's level.
      sendEffort - The flag is false when the Hello body should omit reasoning_effort.
      Returns:
      The return value is the probe future.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception for an empty model, an empty key, or a body that could not be built.

    • modelAfterSlash

      public static String modelAfterSlash(String target)
      The method returns the text after the first / in a target. A null target returns empty. A target with no slash, or with nothing after the slash, returns empty. The returned text is trimmed.
      Parameters:
      target - The target is the stored target string.
      Returns:
      The return value is the text after /, or an empty string.

    • providerId

      public static String providerId(String target)
      The method returns the provider id in front of the first /. A null target or a blank target returns ollama. The id is converted to lower case.
      Parameters:
      target - The target is a stored or outbound target string.
      Returns:
      The return value is the token before /, in lower case.
